entities.summary: Ivan Gazidis is a South African-Greek business executive and former footballer who is currently the President of Kilmer Sports Ventures and the president of AS Saint-Étienne. He previously held executive positions at Italian Serie A club AC Milan, and Premier League club Arsenal.
